name: com.deyaho/phone-calls
title: Deyaho Phone Calls MCP
description: Let any AI place real phone calls with an AI voice agent and get the summary, data and transcript.

tools.name: make_call
tools.description: Place a real outbound phone call with an AI voice agent and get a call_id. The agent introduces itself as an AI assistant of the business you name, pursues the goal you describe, collects the requested data and hangs up. Destinations: Spain (+34), Mexico (+52), United States and Canada (+1), Colombia (+57), Peru (+51) and United Kingdom (+44). With a prepaid key, at their own price per minute (see get_pricing): Argentina, Belize, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Puerto Rico, Uruguay, Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands and Portugal. Calls are short (max 4 minutes). United States and Canada: informational calls only, every day 08:00-21:00 local time of the recipient, with prior_express_consent=true and call_type. Colombia, Peru and United Kingdom: service calls only, Monday to Saturday 09:00-21:00. Set call_purpose: service calls (appointments, reminders, surveys of your own customers, calls the person asked for) run Monday to Saturday 09:00-21:00 local time; commercial calls, only to Spain and Mexico, run Monday to Friday (Spain 09:00-21:00 and only from a 400 number; Mexico 09:00-19:00). In Spain and Mexico, no calls on Sundays or national holidays. You must confirm the recipient asked for or agreed to be contacted. The result is returned by get_call using the call_id. Pass website_url (the business website) and/or business_info so the agent can answer questions about prices, hours or services during the call. The agent speaks with the voice the account chose for the destination country with set_voice or in its dashboard (default: the country voice, Mexico: Emiliano); pass voice (an id or name from list_voices, in the language of the call) only to change it for this call.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +34600111222 or +525512345678

goal.description: What the call must achieve, in plain language

language.description: Language the agent speaks (ISO 639-1). Optional: by default, the language of the destination country (Brazil +55: Brazilian Portuguese; Spain and Latin America: Spanish; US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Belize: English; France: French; Germany and Austria: German; Italy: Italian; Portugal: Portuguese; Netherlands and Belgium: Dutch). Set it only to speak another language.

business_name.description: Name of the business on whose behalf the agent calls

call_purpose.description: service: appointments, reminders, surveys of your own customers, or a call the person asked for. commercial: selling or offering something to someone who did not ask for it. It sets the allowed calling hours; commercial calls to Spain require a 400 number

collect.description: Data points to collect, e.g. ['preferred date', 'email']

consent_confirmed.description: Must be true: the recipient requested or agreed to be contacted

consent_statement.description: How and when the recipient requested or agreed to be contacted

prior_express_consent.description: Required true for +1 destinations: the recipient gave prior consent to be called (TCPA)

call_type.description: Required for +1 destinations: informational calls only, never cold prospecting

website_url.description: Website of the business you call for. It is read before the call (up to 10 pages) so the agent can answer questions about prices, hours, services or address

business_info.description: Extra facts about the business the agent may need (prices, hours, services, policies). The agent answers only with this and the website, never invents

voice.description: Only to change the voice for this call: a voice id or name from list_voices, in the language of the call. Default: the voice the account chose with set_voice or in its dashboard, or the country default (Mexico: Emiliano)

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get the status, duration, summary, collected data and transcript of a call placed with make_call.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List the most recent calls placed with your key (newest first).

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: Free. List the voices the agent can use, by language and country (every destination country, each with a default Fish voice and its sample; Brazil in Brazilian Portuguese), with name, gender and a link to a ~10 s audio sample. Each account picks its voice per country with set_voice (or in its dashboard) and every call uses it; pass a voice id or name as voice in make_call only to change it for one call. Without a chosen voice, the default voice of the destination country is used (Mexico: Emiliano). Signed in, the result also shows your_voices.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language, e.g. es or en

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the accent, e.g. MX, ES or US

tools.name: set_voice
tools.description: Free. Save the agent voice of your account for one destination country (the same setting as the voice picker in app.deyaho.com/dashboard/mcp). Every later call to that country uses it until you change it. Use list_voices to hear the samples and get ids or names; voice="default" goes back to the country default.

country.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (every destination with voices in list_voices: e.g. MX, ES, US, AR, FR, DE, BE)

voice.description: Voice id or name from list_voices for that country, or "default"

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Show the price per call/minute, limits, allowed countries and calling hours, and your remaining balance.
